design_philosophy: Text-only minimalist luxury. Generous spacing, large expressive typography, asymmetrical layouts, and absolute reliance on grid and whitespace over imagery. No product photos. High-end editorial feel.

rules.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl md:text-7xl font-light tracking-tighter leading-none text-[#1C1E1C]
rules.h2: text-3xl sm:text-4xl md:text-5xl font-light tracking-tight leading-tight
rules.body: text-base md:text-lg font-light leading-relaxed tracking-wide text-[#595C58]

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous. Use py-24 to py-32 for section padding.
layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Mode A: The Tetris Grid. Heavy use of asymmetrical column spanning (e.g., col-span-4 vs col-span-8) to create visual tension. Never fill 100% of the grid perfectly.
layout_and_spacing.alignment: Left-aligned dominant for text. Avoid centered blocks unless for specific poetic emphasis.

navigation.classes: fixed top-0 w-full z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#F9F7F3]/70 border-b border-[#E5E0D8]/50 text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.2em]

hero.layout: Min-height 90vh, flex flex-col justify-end pb-24 px-6 md:px-12
hero.elements: Massive typography for 'VELVENYA'. Subtext: 'Silence is the oldest luxury.'

marquee.text_style: font-serif text-2xl md:text-4xl italic tracking-wide text-[#3E4C3B]
marquee.content: Plant-based leather • Conscious craftsmanship • Timeless design •

bento_grid.classes: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-12 px-6 md:px-12 py-24

products_list.item_classes: group flex justify-between items-center py-6 md:py-8 border-b border-[#E5E0D8] cursor-pointer
products_list.text_classes: font-serif text-2xl md:text-4xl text-[#1C1E1C] group-hover:italic group-hover:text-[#3E4C3B] transition-all duration-300

waitlist_form.input_classes: w-full bg-transparent border-b border-[#1C1E1C] rounded-none px-0 py-4 text-lg md:text-2xl focus:outline-none focus:ring-0 focus:border-[#3E4C3B] placeholder-[#595C58]/50
waitlist_form.button_classes: mt-8 px-8 py-4 bg-[#1C1E1C] text-[#F9F7F3] uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-sm hover:bg-[#3E4C3B] transition-colors

motion_and_interaction.entrance: Framer motion fade-up with slight y-axis translation for all text blocks.
motion_and_interaction.hover_states: Text links should have a subtle 1px underline expansion. Product lists italicize on hover.

media.instructions: Strictly NO IMAGES. The entire site relies on typography, negative space, and borders.

testing.requirements: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links) MUST have data-testid attributes.
